g.text: When spread speed is estimated: paired changes in prey-effect recovery

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: First five panels: estimated minus supplied speed. Dots = paired means; bars = 95% bootstrap intervals with calibration and evaluation resampled.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Higher error/width is worse; lower coverage/exclusion/prey score is worse for non-null effects. Null exclusions are false alarms. Final panel: event means, not changes.
